title: Dawn of Light
narrative: Three hundred eighty thousand years after the Big Bang, matter finally cooled enough for light to travel freely. The cosmic microwave background still carries those first whispers, a grainy baby picture of the universe telling us how gravity would sculpt everything that followed.
pauseQuestion: لو رأيت السماء الأولى بلا نجوم ولا عناصر ثقيلة، كيف سيغيّر ذلك طريقة تخيّلنا للقصص العلمية اليوم؟

title: First Stars Ignite
narrative: Gravity gathered the earliest clouds until pressure lit the first, metal-free stars. They burned hot and brief, seeding the darkness with the first heavy elements and carving bubbles that let later galaxies breathe.
pauseQuestion: ما تأثير أن تكون أول النجوم قصيرة العمر على تنوع الكواكب الممكنة لاحقاً؟

title: Galaxies Find Their Lanes
narrative: Filaments of dark matter channeled gas into knots that spun up the first protogalaxies. Collisions, mergers, and stellar winds shaped spirals, ellipticals, and dwarfs that now trace a cosmic web stretching billions of light-years.
pauseQuestion: كيف يغيّر موقع مجرة داخل خيط كوني احتمالات ظهور حياة داخلها؟

title: Black Holes Awake
narrative: Seeds from collapsed giants or dense star clusters fed rapidly, turning into quasars that outshone their host galaxies. Jets from these early giants regulated star formation, setting the rhythm for entire clusters.
pauseQuestion: لو أطفأنا نفثات الثقوب السوداء، هل ستتحول المجرات سريعاً إلى مصانع نجوم مزدحمة؟

title: Elements from Stellar Forges
narrative: Fusion in stellar cores and the violence of supernovae forged carbon, oxygen, and iron. Neutron star collisions sprayed gold and rare elements across space, turning inert clouds into rich chemistry labs.
pauseQuestion: أي العناصر النادرة لو اختفت ستغيّر جذرياً شكل التكنولوجيا التي نستخدمها؟

title: Worlds Assemble
narrative: Around young stars, disks of dust and ice collided, stuck, and shattered again until planets took shape. The placement of giant planets sculpted safe zones or chaos, deciding which worlds could hold onto atmospheres.
pauseQuestion: كيف كان سيتغير تاريخ الأرض لو وُضع كوكب عملاق أقرب للشمس بقليل؟

title: Ingredients for Life
narrative: Organic molecules formed in cold clouds, hitched rides on comets, and rained onto young worlds. Ultraviolet light and geothermal energy stitched them into complex chains, hinting that habitability starts long before oceans appear.
pauseQuestion: ما هو المتغير الأهم لظهور الحياة: وفرة الماء أم طول فترات الاستقرار الحراري؟

title: Eyes on the Sky
narrative: From radio dishes to space telescopes, instruments tuned to every wavelength stacked layers of evidence. Adaptive optics and interferometers sharpened blurred light, letting us weigh exoplanets and time the flicker of distant black holes.
pauseQuestion: أي طول موجي نهمله اليوم قد يكشف لنا في المستقبل طبقات جديدة من الكون؟

title: Future Missions
narrative: Next-generation arrays, sunshades, and cryogenic cameras are being built to read fainter signals. Concepts like starshades, lunar farside radio nets, and kilometer-scale interferometers will stitch together images of exoplanet weather.
pauseQuestion: لو امتلكنا صورة مباشرة لسماء كوكب بعيد، ما السؤال الأول الذي يجب أن نجيب عنه؟

title: Deep Time Perspective
narrative: Galaxies will drift apart faster than light can bridge. Stars will dim, and black holes will evaporate over unimaginable timescales. Our brief moment is a luminous spike in a timeline that will stretch on in silence.
pauseQuestion: مع معرفة أن كل شيء سيندثر، ما المشاريع العلمية التي تستحق بناءها اليوم؟
